name: Fas cell surface death receptor

function.text: FAS encodes tumor necrosis factor receptor superfamily member 6. Annotated molecular activities include signaling receptor activity and tumor necrosis factor receptor activity. It participates in signal transduction and apoptotic process.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to FAS-related autoimmune lymphoproliferative immune disorder (semidominant); autoimmune lymphoproliferative syndrome type 1 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Cervical Squamous Cell Carcinoma; Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma, NOS; Malignant Lymphoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.
